reels.title: Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper leverages the highest-performing category (robotics_tamp) and aligns with the channel's 'The Model Verse' aesthetic of dynamic embodiment; solving Sim-to-Real gaps is highly visual.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do we teach a robot to dance in reality when it only knows how to move in a video game?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A professional athlete using a VR headset to train for the Olympics, then stepping onto the real track for the first time.
